title: MINDS. Anatomy of a Water-rich, Inclined, Brown Dwarf Disk: Lack of Abundant Hydrocarbons
question: What are the inner disk volatile chemical inventory, variability, and dynamical properties (outflowing/infalling activity) of the highly inclined brown dwarf disk 2MASS J04381486+2611399, and why does it lack abundant hydrocarbons compared to other very low-mass star disks?

what.value: System and disk properties of J0438 (distance, spectral type, mass, luminosity, Teff, accretion rate, accretion luminosity, 70 um, 0.89 mm, and 1.3 mm fluxes, inclination, inner and outer disk radii)

external_data.citation: (cite: gaia2021; Manara2023; Luhman2004; Muzerolle2005; Xie2023; Bulger2014; Ward-Duong2018; Scholz2006; Luhman2007)

what.value: Line flux ratios and water complex fluxes for comparison samples of late M-type (M7.25-M4.5) and earlier-type (M3-G0) stars

evidence.quote: As in (cite: Xie2023), we include the sample of late M-type (M$7.25-$M4.5) stars from (cite: Pascucci2009a; Pascucci2013) and earlier-type (M$3-$G0) stars from (cite: banzatti2020). Additionally, we plot available lower limits from recent JWST-MIRI observations of late M-type stars (cite: Arabhavi2025b).

evidence.quote: Next, we generate synthetic spectra to reproduce the continuum-subtracted spectrum assuming plane-parallel slabs of gas in local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) using spectroscopic data from the LAMDA and HITRAN databases (cite: Schoier2005; Gordon2022).

recipe.goal: Reduce JWST-MIRI MRS data and extract 1D spectrum
recipe.method: Process raw data with JWST Calibration Pipeline and VIP routines using pair-wise dither background subtraction, extract 1D spectra with 1.5-FWHM aperture photometry, apply aperture correction factors, and perform residual fringe correction.
assumptions: Source is compact and unresolved for 1D extraction

recipe.goal: Subtract dust continuum from MIRI MRS spectrum
recipe.method: Estimate dust continuum using a Savitzky-Golay filter with a third-order polynomial via pybaselines, iteratively mask emission lines above 2 sigma, subtract continuum, and mask remaining 3 sigma downward spikes.
key_parameters: 3rd order polynomial Savitzky-Golay filter; 2 sigma emission masking; 3 sigma downward spike masking

recipe.goal: Simultaneous LTE slab modelling and line flux measurement
recipe.method: Generate 0D LTE synthetic spectra for H2O, CO2, 13CO2, C2H2, HCN, and OH between 13.4 and 18 um using LAMDA and HITRAN data, convolve to R~2500, resample with SpectRes, and fit all six species simultaneously with emcee MCMC. Integrate continuum-subtracted or best-fit synthetic spectra to obtain line fluxes.
key_parameters: Wavelength range 13.4 to 18 um; spectral resolution R ~ 2500; line width FWHM = 4.7 km/s (sigma = 2 km/s)
assumptions: Plane-parallel slabs of gas in local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE); Gaussian line profile with FWHM = 4.7 km/s; d = 140.26 pc

recipe.goal: Test effect of disk inclination on hydrocarbon visibility and estimate water iceline
recipe.method: Run thermochemical disk models varying inclination from 45 deg to 70 deg to measure change in C2H2 peak flux density; calculate water iceline location using Eq. 19 of Liu et al. (2019).
key_parameters: Inclination varied from 45 deg to 70 deg

recipe.goal: Analyze extended emission across HST/ACS, JWST-MIRI MRS, and ALMA Band 7
recipe.method: Sharpen HST/ACS F814W image using 6 iterations of Lucy-Richardson deconvolution with a field star PSF; construct empirical PSF-subtracted moment 0 maps for MIRI MRS lines (H2 and [Ne+]); inspect archival ALMA Band 7 CO (J=3-2) blue- and red-shifted emission lobes and dust continuum map.
key_parameters: 6 iterations of Lucy-Richardson algorithm for HST; circular apertures of radii 0.5'', 1.0'', 2.5'' and median of 10 surrounding channels (excluding 4 closest) for MIRI PSF subtraction

evidence.quote: According to the formalism presented in (cite: Liu_Beibei_2019) (Eq. 19), we estimate the water iceline to lie at approximately $0.02~$au in the J0438 system (Fig. 5).
